name: gallery-viewport-jump
title: Fix gallery viewport jump
description: Reproduce and eliminate the remaining document viewport jump when a user changes the active Visual Archive thumbnail, then validate and redeploy the production site.
creator: pythonrust
notes: Implementation commit 9d7ee58 was pushed to main and deployed by Cloudflare Pages run 33904697907. Production verification passed all 8 thumbnails at 390x844, 430x932, 768x1024, and 1440x900; Chromium, Firefox 153, and WebKit 26.5 probes all reported delta 0 with overflow-anchor:none.
